coordinateSystem: Top-left origin; integer hull C logical pixels; nearest-neighbour display; paths relative to this manifest

palette.source: All 48 opaque RGB values from shipped deck.png
palette.scope: Runtime assets tall-mast.png and mast-occluder.png; unnormalized source is provenance only

crowsNest.description: Wooden elliptical basket, dark interior and navy lower hoop; pole continues above it

riggingAttachmentPoints.description: Small generated side lugs below basket; ropes supplied by integration

sail.description: Use either existing frame at native scale. Existing cloth is a low reefed sail; larger replacement cloth remains an integration choice. No sail or yard baked into mast.

occluder.description: Exact original lower mast depth overlay. Upper mast is behind crew and new sail; original lower piece still covers crew crossing behind mast.

drawOrder: Hull with old nest/upper mast/ropes removed
New mast at [187,-112] behind sail and crew
Existing or re-fitted sail and rigging
Depth-sorted crew and lower mast occluder, baseline 110
integration.bounds: Allow negative hull y. Existing 426x161 ship rectangle must not clip the mast; tip is y=-110.
integration.previewDescription: 2x review: original left, proposed right, shared deck baseline. Same existing sail and 32px crew. Only upper old rig is cleared; deck-edge rope remnants remain; new long ropes are deliberately omitted. Not a runtime texture.

normalization.implementation: C# System.Drawing; mechanical cleanup of generated art, no procedural drawing
normalization.method: For each output pixel, floor-bounded source block; retain if at least half the block has alpha >=128; channel median of retained RGB; nearest squared-RGB match to exact deck palette; binary alpha; no dithering.
normalization.lowerSection: Original deck.json mast depth piece rows 25..63 copied without changes to mast local [15,185] and occluder [0,25]. Generated source foot is not used.

limitations: Mechanical downsampling retains some uneven wood-grain clusters at enlarged scales, consistent with shipped generated deck art.
The build worker must remove the old baked nest/upper rig, refit long ropes and allow negative hull y. This assets-only branch does not change the running deck.
